description: Search Stayflex for hotel rooms bookable for a few hours during the day (day use, no overnight stay), with live availability and the exact price that will be charged, taxes included. Stayflex partner hotels are in France: around Paris-Charles de Gaulle airport (airport "CDG", for instance for a layover, an early arrival or a late flight) or in a given town. Returns, for each hotel with a free room for the requested slot, the rooms and their prices, the day-use packages sold that day, and a pre-filled link to the hotel's Stayflex page where the traveler books and pays. Read-only: it books and charges nothing.

airport.description: Airport area: "CDG" = Paris-Charles de Gaulle (Roissy). Used by default when neither airport nor city is given.

checkIn.description: Arrival time HH:MM, Paris local time, on a 30-minute grid from 08:30; the stay must end by 22:00. Defaults to 10:00.

city.description: French town name of the hotel, e.g. "Tremblay-en-France", instead of an airport. Case, accents and hyphens do not matter.

date.description: Day of the stay, YYYY-MM-DD (Paris local date).

durationHours.description: Desired length of stay in hours. Hotels sell fixed packages (for example 3, 6 or 10 h): the request is rounded up to the next package. Defaults to the shortest package.

guests.description: Number of guests sharing the room. Defaults to 1.

language.description: Language of the Stayflex web pages linked in the result: "en" (default) or "fr".

name: search_day_use
title: Search day-use hotel rooms
